camel.definition: Cud-chewing mammal used as a draft or saddle animal in desert regions.
camel.exampleUsage: The camel was identified during the lesson.

scorpion.definition: (astrology) a person who is born while the sun is in Scorpio.

rattlesnake.definition: Pit viper with horny segments at the end of the tail that rattle when shaken.

lizard.definition: Relatively long-bodied reptile with usually two pairs of legs and a tapering tail.
lizard.exampleUsage: The lizard was identified during the lesson.

vulture.definition: Any of various large diurnal birds of prey having naked heads and weak claws and feeding chiefly on carrion.
vulture.exampleUsage: The vulture was identified during the lesson.

fennec-fox.definition: A small desert fox from North Africa with very large ears that help it cope with hot conditions.
fennec-fox.exampleUsage: The fennec fox rested in its burrow during the hottest part of the day.

roadrunner.definition: Speedy largely terrestrial bird found from California and Mexico to Texas.
roadrunner.exampleUsage: The roadrunner was identified during the lesson.

tortoise.definition: Usually herbivorous land turtles having clawed elephant-like limbs.

meerkat.definition: A mongoose-like viverrine of South Africa having a face like a lemur and only four toes.

armadillo.definition: Burrowing chiefly nocturnal mammal with body covered with strong horny plates.
armadillo.exampleUsage: The armadillo was identified during the lesson.

coyote.definition: Small wolf native to western North America.

cactus.definition: Any succulent plant of the family Cactaceae native chiefly to arid regions of the New World and usually having spines.

joshua-tree.definition: A tall, branching desert plant in the yucca family, native to the southwestern United States.
joshua-tree.exampleUsage: A Joshua tree stood beside the rocky desert trail.
joshua-tree.arabicTranslation: شجرة جوشوا؛ نوع من اليوكا الصحراوية

palm-tree.definition: A tall tree with long leaves growing in warm climates.

aloe.definition: Succulent plants having rosettes of leaves usually with fiber like hemp and spikes of showy flowers.

agave.definition: Tropical American plants with basal rosettes of fibrous sword-shaped leaves and flowers in tall spikes.

sage-brush.definition: A hardy gray-green shrub that grows widely in dry parts of western North America.
sage-brush.exampleUsage: Sage brush covered the dry ground between the rocks.

prickly-pear.definition: A cactus with flat pads and spines that produces colorful, often edible fruit.
prickly-pear.exampleUsage: The prickly pear produced red fruit after flowering.

barrel-cactus.definition: A round or cylindrical cactus with strong ribs and spines, shaped somewhat like a barrel.
barrel-cactus.exampleUsage: A barrel cactus stored water in its thick stem.

date-palm.definition: A tall palm tree that produces clusters of sweet edible dates.
date-palm.exampleUsage: The date palm provided both fruit and shade.

sand-dune.definition: A raised bank of loose sand forms when wind carries and deposits grains, typically in deserts or along lakeshores and coasts.

canyon.definition: A ravine formed by a river in an area with little rainfall.

oasis.definition: A fertile tract in a desert (where the water table approaches the surface).

dry-riverbed.definition: The channel or ground where a river normally flows but that currently contains little or no water.
dry-riverbed.exampleUsage: The hikers followed the dry riverbed through the valley.

rocky-outcrop.definition: An exposed mass or area of rock that projects from the surrounding ground.
rocky-outcrop.exampleUsage: A lizard rested on the rocky outcrop in the sun.

crater.definition: A faint constellation in the Southern Hemisphere near Hydra and Corvus.

basin.definition: The quantity that a basin will hold.

water-canteen.definition: A portable container designed for carrying drinking water, especially outdoors.
water-canteen.exampleUsage: She filled her water canteen before crossing the desert.

sun-hat.definition: A hat with a wide brim helps shield the face from direct sunlight.

sunscreen.definition: A cream spread on the skin.

sunglasses.definition: (plural) spectacles that are darkened or polarized to protect the eyes from the glare of the sun.

compass.definition: An area in which something acts or operates or has power or control:.

map.definition: A drawing that shows places, routes, and geographical features.

shade.definition: Protective covering that protects something from direct sunlight.

tent.definition: A temporary shelter made from fabric and supported by poles.

first-aid-kit.definition: A portable set of medical supplies and equipment provides immediate help for minor injuries or sudden illness while professional care is unavailable.

water-filter.definition: A device or material that removes unwanted particles or substances from water.
water-filter.exampleUsage: The group used a water filter before drinking from the supply.

sandstorm.definition: A windstorm that lifts up clouds of dust or sand.

heat-wave.definition: A period of unusually hot weather.

mirage.definition: An optical illusion in which atmospheric refraction by a layer of hot air distorts or inverts reflections of distant objects.

drought.definition: A long period with very little or no rain.

hot-sun.definition: Strong sunlight that creates intense heat, especially in a warm climate.
hot-sun.exampleUsage: They rested in the shade to avoid the hot sun.

cool-night.definition: A night when the air temperature feels noticeably low or pleasantly cool.
cool-night.exampleUsage: The desert became quiet during the cool night.

dust-devil.definition: A small, short-lived vortex, or spinning column, of dust and air forms when intense ground heating makes air rise. The rotating air lifts dust from the surface.

clear-sky.definition: A sky without clouds, allowing the sun or stars to be seen.

starry-night.definition: A night when many stars can be clearly seen in the sky.
starry-night.exampleUsage: They watched the Milky Way on a clear, starry night.

nomad.definition: A member of a people who have no permanent home but move about according to the seasons.

caravan.definition: A procession (of wagons or mules or camels) traveling together in single file.

campfire.definition: An outdoor fire built for warmth, cooking, or light.

bedouin-tent.definition: A traditional portable tent used by Bedouin communities, often made from woven animal hair or wool.
bedouin-tent.exampleUsage: The family welcomed the travelers into a Bedouin tent.

well.definition: A deep hole in the ground used for collecting water.

irrigation.definition: Supplying dry land with water by means of ditches etc.

petroglyph.definition: A carving or line drawing on rock (especially one made by prehistoric people).

sand-castle.definition: A model of a castle or other structure shaped from damp sand.
sand-castle.exampleUsage: The children built a sand castle beside the dunes.

footprint.definition: The area taken up by some object.

sage.definition: Of the grey-green color of sage leaves.

desert-rose.definition: A drought-tolerant succulent shrub with a thick stem and showy pink, red, or white flowers.
desert-rose.exampleUsage: The desert rose opened bright pink flowers after the warm season began.

sunset.definition: The time in the evening at which the sun begins to fall below the horizon.
